text.en: Owners frequently praise Lulu for her thoughtful and caring approach to boarding. Clients highlight her genuine dedication, noting that she treats each visiting pet like family and provides regular photo and video updates that give families peace of mind while away on holiday.

title.en: Comfort for sensitive and playful pets

text.en: Pet parents note that dogs settle in easily and enjoy socialising with other canine guests. Reviewers with sensitive toy poodles and active puppies mention that their pets return relaxed, happy, and well exercised after daily playtime and attentive cuddles.

Clients appreciate the tidy, clean, and welcoming domestic environment provided during both day care and overnight boarding stays. Multiple owners describe the setting as a reassuring home away from home where dogs can rest safely in a calm household setting.

q.en: What types of care does Itsadogsworldlondon provide?

a.en: The service offers home-style dog boarding, daycare, and daily sitting routines with personalised attention for visiting dogs.

q.en: How are anxious or sensitive dogs accommodated?

a.en: Reviewers note that sensitive pets are introduced gently to other dogs and receive dedicated companionship and calm handling in a quiet domestic environment.

q.en: Do owners receive updates during boarding stays?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention receiving reassuring messages, photos, and video updates showing their pets enjoying playtime and rest.
